title: State-dependent NAMPT-axis transcriptional programs in obesity and exercise (analysis code)
description: Analysis code and derived data for the NAMPT-axis transcriptional-program manuscript: public-data audit, NAMPT-axis scoring, random-effects meta-analysis, module consistency, cell-composition proxy, Phase 1b sensitivity, moderator feasibility, Evo2-40B regulatory-variant prioritization and GTEx/GWAS merge.
